escalationBullets: If the WAN IP of your own router is private, there is definitely another upstream routing layer.
recommendedActions: Check whether your ISP device and your own router are both doing routing.
If possible, put one device into bridge / passthrough mode.
Otherwise forward on the upstream router as well.
Check whether both the ISP device and another router or mesh system are routing.
Put one device into bridge / passthrough mode when possible.
expected.summary: Most likely cause: You may be behind two routers.

notes: `double-nat` has 4 `anyOf` requirements, so `max(1, 4/2) == 2` matches are needed for `strong`; only 1 present here yields `possible`. Also a real (not synthetic) dedup case: the double-nat topic's own suggestedNextActions and the double-nat rule's nextActions share one identical string ("Otherwise forward on the upstream router as well.") — recommendedActions has 5 entries, not 6, because deduplicatedStrings collapses it.
